why: Response 1 names the crux precisely: whether ad-driven CPA falls below the break-even of ¥20,000 × gross margin. It gives dated steps with explicit stop and scale rules and lists what is unknown, though the council jargon hurts readability. Response 2 is clearer and does useful math, but it relies on an assumed 60% margin and scenario numbers. Its ¥15,000 stop rule is also above its own ¥12,000 break-even, and its steps have no dates.
